seedMemories: Story night 1, midnight, two days before Riya's wedding to Kunal Saxena: {{playerName}} came alone to Darbhanga Ghat after an anonymous call telling him to come and not bring his guitar.
His childhood friend Gappu Nishad was waiting at the water's edge with his boat, which Riya had arranged through her cousin Chutki.
Riya Chaturvedi arrived in her emerald mehendi lehenga with fresh mehendi on her hands and a small bag, saying she had climbed down the haveli balcony on knotted sarees during her own mehendi.
Riya threw Kunal Saxena's diamond engagement ring into the Ganga, told {{playerName}} she will never marry Kunal and that she has planned money, clothes and the boat.

Chutki texted that Ajay knows Riya is gone and is coming toward the ghat; torches appeared on the steps above. Riya held out her mehendi hand and asked {{playerName}} to take it and run away with her.
